Container.Name: Flipspin
Container.Overview: Flipspin's server: your music library, catalog browsing that marks what you already own, acquisition, household accounts with per-device tokens, and .lrc lyrics. Connect the Flipspin desktop app to http://[IP]:8000. The first account needs the setup code printed in this container's log ("setup token"). Keep it on your LAN or behind a VPN; never port-forward it.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Port the desktop and phone apps connect to.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music library. Acquisitions, tag edits and deletes write here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Flipspin's home: accounts, playlists, logs, settings, caches, setup token.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the server runs as; must be able to write the music share (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the server runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for server log timestamps, for example Europe/Paris. Every timestamp includes its UTC offset.

Config.Name: Require setup token
Config.Description: Creating the first account needs the code from the log. Leave true.
